text: Curai convention: a handoff carries references only, and the receiving tool re-reads the source record.
Curai convention: no tool produces a handoff today, so an agent must not assume one.
Curai convention: AI output needs a person's review. Generated doesn't mean approved.
Curai convention: unreadable or unsure content goes to a person and is never guessed.
Curai convention: the Curai database is the record, and shared context is supplemental.
